known_gaps.description: Challenge v3 is byte-verified 22/22 and runnable 21/22. Woody toy003 remains blocked until the exact verified BrickLink asset with SHA-256 777fd93e31997b912debb734bf0be461c6795210649370bd6be92717f948e7c9 can be directly visually inspected.

Set 276-1 provides instruction-confirmed assembled nurse/child identity and BrickLink component assemblies, but Brickmen still needs a byte-pinned, visually reviewed clean single-figure asset before admitting lego_homemaker_maxifigure_legacy to the evaluation cohort.
Fifteen deterministic sanitized derivative candidates for the original 27-case benchmark are hash-pinned but require direct local visual review before model input approval.
Eight original benchmark cases require primary-figure segmentation. SAM2 prompt seeds and wrapper exist, but outputs require a capable local SAM2 environment and visual approval.
The 744 high-priority source->LEGO pairs are batched and reviewable, but canonical supervision still requires submitted reviews, second reviews where needed, and explicit adjudication.
Exact rear/side/physical evidence remains limited and must not be synthesized.
Lower- versus upper-torso segment length remains underidentified until additional chest/torso-center landmarks are added.

highest_value_tasks.task: Byte-pin and visually gate a specific 276-1 Homemaker nurse or child assembled-figure reference; add the legacy Homemaker architecture only if exact-release identity and leakage-safety gates pass.
Resolve the exact-hash Woody toy003 raw visual review without substituting an alternate image.
Visually review the original benchmark's 15 deterministic sanitized candidates and rebuild the model-input manifest from exact approvals.
Run and review the original benchmark's 8 hash-pinned SAM2 segmentation candidates in a capable local runtime.
Execute Fortnite first-review, second-review, and adjudication batches; promote only explicit adjudicated supervision.
Expand exact-release multi-view ReferenceSets and cross-surface correspondence without inventing hidden views.
Evaluate the three remaining concrete custom architecture gaps: custom_midfig_balljoint_upper, custom_sidan_full_balljoint_poseable, and custom_standard_four_arm_single_torso.
Extract official visual grammar from evidence and build negative/failure critic data.
Maintain current model, dataset, paper, and tool registry.
